g.text: To charge the LIPO, insert the battery in the JST PH connector and connect USB at the same time.
RF Transmission Line Coplanar Waveguide w/GND plane - 2.4 GHZ - FR4 with 4.7 er and 1.5mm isolation - 0.035mm copper thickness - 0.2mm isolation on top layer - 1.06mm transmission line = 51.6 ohm
Dynamic VIN selection: VBUS (USB) will override VBAT (LIPO) via D1 when both are present.
